description: Your Loom library as a local, searchable archive: grep what you said, back up everything, and recap a week in one command.

novel_features.name: Spoken-word grep
novel_features.description: Find the exact moment you said something in any hydrated video, with a link that jumps straight to it.

novel_features.name: Transcript and AI backfill
novel_features.description: Pull transcripts plus Loom's own summaries, chapters and action items for every video sync has stored, in one resumable pass.

novel_features.name: Reach deltas
novel_features.description: See which recent videos got new views, comments or reactions since your last check (the first run records the baseline), and which comments still need a reply.

novel_features.name: Window digest
novel_features.description: One markdown recap of a week's videos with Loom's summaries, chapter links and action items.
